title: Paired Bluetooth devices
whyItMatters: The Bluetooth port key has one subkey per paired device. It shows headsets, phones and other hardware that belonged to this machine.
notes: Machine-wide pairing records. Only subkey and value counts are reported; device addresses and link keys are never read.

steps: For each device in the list, select More options (...) and choose Remove device.
Turn Bluetooth off once the list is empty.
cleanup.risk: The PC forgets every paired device, and they must be paired again to connect. No device is changed in any way.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Support, Troubleshoot transferring files using Bluetooth: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/hardware/bluetooth/troubleshoot-transferring-files-using-bluetooth
